label: JUSTICE_2: a GOD_4 with classical attributes wills every act due to some being
definition: GodRendersAllDue: for every g with IsGod and HasClassicalAttributes, every being x and act a, if a is due to x then g wills a. A completeness reading of giving each what is due; it is not entailed by JUSTICE_1.
note: Analyst sense of the distributive formula in ST I q.21 a.1 co. (giving each what his rank deserves), read as completeness. Aquinas's own reply to the afflicted-just objection (a.4 ad 3) and the derivation of creaturely debt from wisdom (a.1 ad 3) suggest he does not hold the unrestricted reading; it is recorded because the problem of suffering bears on it.
